instructions.question: Where is the person in getting what they want?

criteria.exploring: I don't have a particular thing in mind yet. Show me what is out there.
criteria.comparing: I have a few candidates in mind and want to weigh them against each other.
criteria.deciding: I am about to say yes or no to one specific thing, and want to be sure first.
criteria.committing: I have decided. Let me give the details or the go-ahead and make it happen.
criteria.doing: I am in the middle of a hands-on task and need guidance while I do it.
criteria.checking: Something already happened or is under way. I want to see how it stands.

instructions.question: What is true for the person when this goes well?

criteria.know: I understand something I did not understand before.
criteria.picked: I have settled on one option out of several.
criteria.handed_over: I have given my details or my go-ahead, and the thing is now in motion.
criteria.finished_task: I have completed a hands-on task out in the real world.
criteria.reassured: I have stopped worrying about something.
criteria.configured: A product's settings or preferences are now set the way I like them.
